turns.question: What was the median number of days from application to hire for candidates hired in September or October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no median metric; its closest metric, Time to hire (days), is an average and gives 6.08 days from application to hire for candidates hired 2026-09-01 to 2026-10-31. Late: recruitment.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
